title: The loop's test app never asks the person for a screen or audio permission over and over
goal: While the loop tested, Photonz Probe kept putting up a macOS screen or audio recording permission dialog; the user denied it and it came straight back, again and again. Whatever the probe asks for, a person's answer must stick: asked at most once, and never again after a no.
notes: User, 2026-11-26 ~11:45: "i am getting an endless loop of permission requests for photonz probe and i keep deny and it pops back up"; they said the dialog was about screen or audio recording. The intake window stopped the loop (11:50) and restarted it at 12:01 after the user chose to allow it once. Not reproduced by me: I could not read TCC.db or see the dialog, and `log show` with tccd predicates returned nothing from this shell. The runner at the time was the scrubbing task, running Scripts/playtest.sh /tmp/scrub-like.json repeatedly (speed walk play and scrub on reference edit 6); the speed walk itself has no ScreenCaptureKit call (grep), so the request likely comes from app launch paths (ProbeGrants.recordOnLaunch, CaptureCenter, the recorder warm up in Sources/Photonz/Capture/ScreenRecorder.swift:177, RecordingCoordinator.swift:61) or a snapshot step. Probe is signed with the stable Photonz Dev cert (codesign Authority=Photonz Dev), so a changing code identity is not the cause. Sits right after the-loop-s-test-app-never-plays-sound-out-of-the, which also touches what the probe sends to the person.
acceptance: Find what asks, with evidence: launch the probe the way walks do (Scripts/probe-app.sh, Scripts/playtest.sh on the speed walk and a snapshot walk) while `log stream --predicate 'process == "tccd" OR subsystem == "com.apple.TCC" OR subsystem == "com.apple.replayd" OR process == "universalaccessd"'` runs, and name the call that raises it (ScreenCaptureKit content query, screenshot, a stream, system audio capture, the recorder's warm up, ProbeGrants.recordOnLaunch) and the TCC service it hits. dist/probe-grants.json said screenRecording true, prompted false at 11:37 on 2026-11-26, so it is not the plain Screen Recording grant: the likely suspects are macOS's recurring screen capture confirmation (bypassing the private window picker) or System Audio Recording.

Fix: after any answer the probe never raises that dialog again in that launch or the next (preflight before every request; a denied answer is recorded beside the probe like probe-grants.json and respected; walks that need the capture report 'not granted' as their own outcome instead of asking). The person's dev and release apps follow the same once-only rule (memory: bound OS permission requests to once per launch).
A drill: launch the probe ten times in a row with the capture denied (or stubbed as denied) and show no request call is made after the first; runs with the focus drill.

Say in the audit what the person should answer if the dialog is shown once, and what is lost if they deny (which walks go unanswered). Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: Reproduced and identified. The dialog is macOS's Screen Recording request ('Photonz Probe would like to record this computer's screen and audio', Open System Settings / Deny), drawn by universalAccessAuthWarn; one was still on screen behind the terminal at 12:45 (photographed through a new probe-only --window-peek diag). The user's 12 clicks at 11:37:50-11:38:16 each brought the next one up 30 ms later with NO request from the probe in between (log: no probe TCCAccessRequest 11:37:35-11:38:30), so it was a backlog, not a live loop. Drill with a never-granted throwaway app: CGRequestScreenCaptureAccess AND a plain SCShareableContent query each hand tccd a prompt that universalAccessAuthWarn queues behind the one showing (order window 0x56ec8), the call returns at once, the dialog outlives the app, and after a Deny the next call queues another ('The user declined TCCs' and still prompts). So 'once per launch' is a storm for a probe the loop launches hundreds of times a sweep: every launch without the grant (ProbeGrants.recordOnLaunch) and every unguarded SCK call adds one. Today the probe IS granted (tccd auth_value=2, every launch preflight only), so nothing new is queued now; the backlog came from earlier ungranted runs (dialog host running since Nov 3). Cleared the stale dialog by restarting universalAccessAuthWarn.
owns these walks: never-granting-walk, setup-steps-brand-new-mac-walk, setup-steps-everything-done-walk

Fixed. PermissionAskPolicy (core, 6 tests) + PermissionGate: never ask when granted; person's app once per launch; probe once EVER (dist/probe-permission-asks.json). ProbeGrants asks through it; prime makes one SCK request instead of CGRequest+SCK (two queued dialogs per ask; chose SCK-only because the SCK query both lists the app in Settings and raises the request); every ScreenCaptureKit capture, recorder warmUp/start and the menu-picture step check the grant first (ScreenCapturer.requireGrant, RecorderError.notGranted); the probe never opens a Settings pane; both mic requests go through the gate. Drill queue/bin/permission-drill.sh: 10 launches read as ungranted -> 1 ask, 9 'asked before', no real dialog (window list empty); runs at the end of focus-drill.sh. Walks green: never-granting, setup-steps-brand-new-mac, setup-steps-everything-done, a-captured-window-s-shadow, a-busy-recording, opening-a-recording, redline, svg-export-redline. Scripts/test.sh green (second run; first run had IconPreviewRenderTests speed budget over under load, passes alone, unrelated). Left rough, not filed: how the probe lost its grant before today is unknowable from logs (tccd detail persists minutes); no follow-up clears the bar, since nothing is broken now and the drill guards the rule.

Found: the dialog was macOS's Screen Recording request for Photonz Probe, a backlog stacked one per ungranted request (macOS 26 queues a dialog per CGRequest or SCK call, even after Deny; the probe asked per launch, twice). Shipped 0fb59679f: PermissionAskPolicy (core, tested) + PermissionGate: never when granted, person once per launch, probe once ever (dist/probe-permission-asks.json); one request per ask; every capture checks the grant first; probe never opens Settings. queue/bin/permission-drill.sh: 10 launches -> 1 ask (runs in focus-drill). Walks + Scripts/test.sh green. Audit queue/audits/2026-11-26-probe-asks-once.json.
